claim: Why so much hate for Breitbart? : r/AskALiberal - Reddit
summary: I once spent an evening combing through some Breitbart articles. An exercise in getting to know the other side, ya know? Every single article I read was in some way grossly distorting the truth to fit their narrative. So many examples of spurious uses of statistics or setting up and knocking down strawman arguments to puff up their own nonsense. There's so much hate for Breitbart on the left ...
